newsitem.title: UK: Vitec gains 3 pct after 1996 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Vitec gains 3 pct after 1996 profit rise.

text.p: Shares in Vitec Group Plc gained 19-1/2p, or 3.06 percent, to 657-1/2 pence after the group, which supplies equipment to the broadcast and photographic industry, reported record 1996 profits.
"The results look good," one market maker said.
Vitec's pre-tax profit before exceptional items rose to 36.6 million stg from 30.7 million.
The dividend was raised 15 percent to 12.1 pence with Vitec citing its continuing high dividend cover and good outlook as reasons for the hike.

"Strong world market share in niche markets and efficient international design and manufacturing, again proved a winning formula to produce record trading profits," chief executive Malcolm Baggott said in a statement.
